TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TO SECTION 98-33(a) OF THE ZONING RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF NEW YORK TRANSFER AND DISTRIBUTION, made as of the 26# day of Septewbec, company,with an address at c/o Related,60 Columbus Circle, New York,New York 10023 ("Transferor"), and WEST 30TH HIGHLINE HOLDINGS, L.L.C., a New York limited liability company, with an address at c/o Related, 60 Columbus Circle, New York, New York 10023 ("Transferee").
